pr_title: Update devtools-extensions build script to reflect changes in local b…
pr_body:
## Summary

Updates the `react-devtools-extensions` build script to reflect changes in the local build directory structure. Specifically, the current build code assumes (in the webpack conf) the existence of `<repo_root>/build/node_modules` with either a local build or pulled from remote builds.

The changes made in #20581 changed the build output folder to `build2/oss-experimental`. Code was added in that PR to copy from `build2/oss-experimental` to `build/node_modules`, presumably to support this script, however the local build scenario was probably not considered.

This PR adds a check that validates that the build artifacts exist in `build/node_modules` and copies the `build2/oss-experimental` folder to `build/node_modules`.

I also added more refined logic to choose the correct Firefox profile based on whether the user set the `WEB_EXT_FIREFOX` env variable.

Fixes #20997


## Test Plan
